reason: I'd use the free visit on a Saturday and probably pay for one drop-in after that if my kid liked it. We'd go once or twice a month at most, so a membership or a 5-pack makes no sense for us.
objection: We only get Saturdays, so I'd go once or twice a month. $15 a visit with coffee is fine for that, but a membership would never pay off, and Saturdays will probably be the most crowded time.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend-only pack that doesn't expire for a few months, or a drop-in closer to $10 for a Saturday.
